title: Green Top Shooting Range

services.name: Lane Rentals
services.desc: Walk in, check in with our Pro Staff, and enjoy a clean, professional indoor range built for safe practice. Rates are hourly and apply to walk-in lane use. Up to two people may share one lane, with one exception: one parent may share with two minors ages 13-20. Two people age 21 or older must be present for walk-in firearm rentals. Please see any GTSR Pro Staffer with questions. Shooters must be 21 or accompanied by someone who is 21 or older.
